turns.text: Hello. The print arrived with the wrong colours. The sky is green and it should be blue.
Hello, and I'm sorry the print arrived with the wrong colours. To look into this, I need your order number (SC- and four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
Order SC-5219, email nymue.strambu@example.com. It was delivered recently.

Thank you, Nymue. I have filed a damage claim (R-1) for order SC-5219, the print 'Cameleonul de noapte' 30x40 cm, with the wrong colours: the sky is green instead of blue. Staff must approve it. They will ask you for a photo of the print and decide whether you get a reprint or a refund. You do not need to choose yet, but if you already know which you prefer, tell me.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.
